correctness.rationale: With W_i=C[V_i], augmentation ε_i and U_i=ker ε_i, all allowed 1-paths are ⊕ W_i⊗W_{i+1}. Every 2-path has only the missing middle-deletion shortcut to layer i+2 (n=3 still distinct), so Ω2^N=⊕ W_i⊗U_{i+1}⊗W_{i+2}; higher allowable conditions in degree2 are vacuous. For x⊗u⊗z, ∂=ξ²ε(z)x⊗u in E_i + ε(x)u⊗z in E_{i+1}. Decomposition W_i=C w_i ⊕U_i (ε(w_i)=1) shows U_i⊗U_{i+1} killed and the only remaining relations ξ²(w_i⊗u)_(E_i)+(u⊗w_{i+2})_(E_{i+1}); each U-block independent, hence E/im∂Ω2≅⊕W_i⊗w_{i+1}, exactly the proposed canonical averaging map. Symmetry of normalized layer averages yields full vertex-permutation character. On degree0 arrows impose [v_{i+1}]=−ξ[v_i]; complete arcs collapse within-layer classes and the cycle closes iff (−ξ)^n=1. The order of −ξ for primitive ξ=exp(2πik/N), gcd(k,N)=1, is 2N/gcd(N+2k,2N), which equals 2N/gcd(N+2,2N) in each residue class of N. Independently checked gcd formula for N=3,4,5,6,8,10,12 and inspected the source finite-field path-complex verifier; universal conclusion follows from the exact block decomposition, not tests.
